technical-data.invention-title: DRAINAGE OUTLET PART OF BRIDGE GULLY
BOUCHE D'EVACUATION DE CONDUITE D'ECOULEMENT DE PONT

abstract.p: The outlet is adjustable in the direction of pipeline and is situated in the bottom of the plate (1) of the bridge gully and further in the plate (1) a pot with drainage apertures is situated. Drainage outlet part is compound of articulation (3), which is created by segment (4), filler (7), middle part (5) and revolving part (6). The bottom part of the filler (7) is connected to middle part (5) in a shape of hemisphere with bottom edge skewed in a bent that is parallel with the bent of the side of the filler (7) and at the same time skewed accordingly to the top edge of the revolving part (6), which is also hemisphere shaped and from which in a bottom side a flat end of the pipeline exhausts. In the flange (13) circle reduction (2) with central aperture (10) is fast mounted. The central aperture (10) is equipped with selecting (9) around its perimeter used for mounting the top part of segment (4).

L'invention se rapporte à une bouche d'évacuation de conduite d'écoulement de pont qui peut être réglée dans la direction de la conduite et qui est placée sur le fond de la plaque d'appui (1) de ladite conduite d'écoulement, ladite plaque (1) présentant une partie creuse dotée d'orifices d'évacuation. Cette bouche d'évacuation est composée d'une articulation (3) formée d'un segment (4), d'une garniture (7), d'une partie intermédiaire (5) et d'une partie rotative (6). La partie inférieure de la garniture (7) est reliée à la partie intermédiaire (5) de manière à présenter une forme d'hémisphère avec un bord inférieur à l'oblique suivant une courbure qui est parallèle à la courbure du bord de la garniture (7) et également à l'oblique par rapport au bord supérieur de la partie rotative (6), qui présente également une forme d'hémisphère et à partir de laquelle est située pour l'évacuation en partie inférieure une extrémité plate de la conduite. Un organe de réduction circulaire (2) doté d'une ouverture centrale (10) est monté de manière rapide dans la bride (13). Ladite ouverture centrale (10) est munie sur sa circonférence d'organes de sélection (9) qui permettent la fixation de la partie supérieure du segment (4).

description.p: Drainage outlet part of bridge gully
Technology area
Invention solves drainage part of bridge gully, which is adjustable in the direction of pipeline.
Actual state of technolopy

Actually known principles of outflow of rain water out of surfaces of bridges and bridge isolation are resolved by fixed outflow pipeline which is lead either upright down or is laid in a fixed angle considering the direction of the water outflow.
Disadvantage of this solution is the fixed mounting without any possibility of change of direction.

Known solution is a bridge gully where its outlet aperture situated in the bottom of the pot of the bully leads straight upright down. This solution does not allow directing the outlet aperture to outlet pipeline below the bridge. This solution causes extremely big disadvantages in reconstruction of original drainage systems of bridges because connecting to original system is necessary.
Fundamentals of the invention

The disadvantages mentioned above are removed by drainage outlet part of bridge gully which is adjustable in the direction of pipeline and which is situated in the bottom of plate of bridge gully and further in the plate a pot with drainage apertures is situated. It contains a grating; its frame is seated on a rectification. The fundamental of the product is in the fact that it is assembled from articulation, which is created by segment, filler, middle part and revolving part. In the bottom of the plate there is an aperture. On the perimeter of the aperture there is a flange and further below skewed part. In it a filler segment is situated and below it there is filler. Bottom part of the filler connects to middle part in a shape of hemisphere with bottom edge skewed in a bent that is parallel with the bent of the side of the filler and at the same time skewed accordingly to the top edge of the revolving part, which is also hemisphere shaped and from which in a bottom side a flat end of the pipeline exhausts.
In the flange part of the aperture a circular reduction with central aperture is fast mounted. The central aperture is equipped with selecting in its perimeter for mounting to the top part of the segment, which is shape equivalent to the selecting. There is a circle jointing between the middle part and the revolving part.
Installation of the outlet pipeline below the bridge in any angle in range of 360 degrees is the advantage of proposed solution.

Solution according to the invention makes installation of the outlet pipeline easy especially in reconstruction of old bridges. The installation is easy and is practised from the surface of bridge construction.

Examples of design of the invention

Plate 1 of the bridge gully was made of cast iron. In its bottom there is aperture .1.1. with flange 3 around its perimeter and with part 14 of the aperture H skewed in inner direction. Plastic articulation 3 is mounted using segment 4 in this aperture V\_. The articulation 3 is compound of filler 7, middle part 5 and revolving part 6. Filler 7 is connected to the middle part 5 in a shape of hemisphere, which has the bottom edge skewed. The skew angle is identical to the top edge of the revolving part 6 of the articulation 3. It has also shape of hemisphere but it is inverse situated. At the bottom side a flat end of the pipeline exhausts from the hemisphere of the revolving part 6. Between the middle part 5 of the articulation and the revolving part 6 a jointing circle 12 is situated.

In flange 13 there is a circle reduction 2 in which central aperture 10 is. The central aperture 10 is equipped with selecting 9 in its perimeter. The top part of the segment 4 is shaped same as the central aperture 10. Rotating the reduction 2 against the central aperture 10 with 90 degrees mounts the segment 4 top part in the plate 1
because the reduction 2 is fixed in the plate with screws that are situated in holders
8 around the perimeter of the reduction 2. Toughening of the whole outlet part of the device is solved this way.

The function of this device consists in the revolving connection of mostly cast iron plate 1 of the bridge gully with plastic articulation 3. The articulation 3 can be set in the direction of the original drainage pipeline of the bridge.
Reduction 2 allows connecting of different materials, most often metal and plastics, and also fast connection of parts of the device at the same time.
Industrial usability
Device according to the invention is usable in construction of bridge sewerage, in solution of the rain water outflow off the bridge surface.

claim.claim-text: 1. Drainage outlet part of bridge gully, which is adjustable in the direction of pipeline and is situated in the bottom of the plate (1) of the bridge gully and further in the plate (1) is situated a pot with drainage apertures and frame with grating seated on a rectification, which is characterized with its composition of articulation (3) assembled from segment (4), filler (7), middle part (5) and revolving part (6), where in the bottom of the plate (1) is aperture (11) and around it there is a flange (13), below the flange (13) there is a skewed part (14) in which is situated a filler segment (4), below the filler segment (4) there is a filler (7), it's bottom part is connected to middle part (5) in a shape of hemisphere with bottom edge skewed in a bent that is parallel with the bent of the side of the filler (7) and at the same time skewed accordingly to the top edge of the revolving part (6), which is also hemisphere shaped and from which in a bottom side a flat end of the pipeline exhausts, where the flange (13) circle reduction (2) with central aperture (10) is fast mounted and the central aperture (10) is equipped with selecting (9) around its perimeter used for mounting the top part of segment (4), which is of the same shape as the selecting (9).
2. Drainage outlet part of bridge gully according to claim 1. distinguished by a jointing circle (12) situated between the middle part (5) and the revolving part (6) of the articulation (3).
